Indian Princess's Century-Old US Home Showcases Royal Heritage

Princess Padmaja Kumari Parmar, reportedly from one of the world's oldest dynasties, owns a 100-year-old home in the United States. The residence is described as palace-like and is adorned with valuable Indian artifacts, showcasing royal Indian heritage abroad.
